_說明: lecture-gather 工作流的課程設定。複製到 <教材庫>/courses/<課程名>/gather.json 後改寫；以 _ 開頭的鍵只是說明，工作流不讀。
範例值是 2026-09 牙醫系「免疫疾病」課程（Robbins 11e 第6章，印刷頁 = PDF 頁 + 166）。
三個部分 exam／literature／facts 各自可關："enabled": false，或執行時給 args.parts。沒有的部分直接刪掉也可以。
頁圖資料夾與 page_offset 不寫在這裡：工作流從 course.yaml 的 textbook.pages_dir、textbook.page_offset 讀。
facts.segments[].pages 是 PDF 頁（頁圖檔名 pNN_PPP 的 NN）；id 必須是 S01–S99，scripts/merge_facts.py 只合併 facts/seg/S??_final.json。
literature.topics[].r 寫「教科書已經講了什麼」（附印刷頁），讓搜尋者只找補充、不找重複；用自己的話摘要，不要整段抄教科書。
exam.bank 是 <工具包>/question_banks/ 下的資料夾名（醫師、牙醫師…）；醫師題庫只用題號 76–100。update_bank 設成物件時才會先下載新場次。
context: We are building a 3-hour 免疫疾病 pathology lecture for 3rd-year DENTAL students (牙醫三, course code C) taught by the course's pathology teacher.

textbook.name: Robbins, Cotran & Kumar Pathologic Basis of Disease 11th ed, Chapter 6 "Diseases of the Immune System" (printed pages 167-235)

exam.exam_name: 專門職業及技術人員高等考試 牙醫師(一) 牙醫學(二)（口腔病理學、牙科材料學、口腔微生物學與免疫學、牙科藥理學）；109 年起分階段，104–108 年為分階段前含口腔病理學與口腔微生物學／免疫學的試卷

_update_bank_例.exam: 牙醫師(一) 牙醫學(二)

exam.scope: normal immune response (innate/adaptive, receptors, lymphocytes, MHC/HLA, cytokines, antibodies, lymphoid tissues), hypersensitivity types I-IV, tolerance & autoimmunity, SLE, Sjögren syndrome, systemic sclerosis, inflammatory myopathies, MCTD, vasculitis (as in ch.6), IgG4-related disease, transplant rejection, GVHD, primary immunodeficiencies (innate & adaptive defects, complement deficiencies incl. hereditary angioedema), secondary immunodeficiency, HIV/AIDS (incl. oral lesions of HIV), amyloidosis
exam.include_also: oral-medicine questions about these diseases (e.g., pemphigus as type II, lichenoid reaction as type IV, oral candidiasis in HIV)

sections: 第一節 = normal immunity review + hypersensitivity I-IV
第二節 = autoimmunity (SLE, Sjögren, systemic sclerosis, IgG4-RD...) + transplant/GVHD
第三節 = immunodeficiency (primary, HIV/AIDS with oral lesions) + amyloidosis
recommend.prefer: recent years, clear stems, dental relevance, no duplicates in concept

topics.q: 先天免疫缺陷與牙周炎：白血球黏附缺陷(leukocyte adhesion deficiency; LAD)、Chediak-Higashi 症候群、慢性肉芽腫病(chronic granulomatous disease; CGD)、嗜中性球減少的口腔表現（早發性／侵襲性牙周炎、口腔潰瘍）
topics.r: Robbins p.213-214 (Table 6.12): LAD1 = defective beta2 integrin (CD18), LAD2 = absent sialyl-Lewis X (fucosyl transferase); recurrent bacterial infections; CGD = NADPH oxidase defect; Chediak-Higashi = defective lysosomal fusion (LYST). Ch.6 does not mention periodontitis or gingivitis.

topics.q: 遺傳性血管性水腫(hereditary angioedema; HAE)與牙科處置：拔牙等處置誘發上呼吸道水腫、術前預防
topics.r: Robbins p.214: C1 inhibitor deficiency causes hereditary angioedema; episodic edema of skin and mucosa (larynx, GI tract), often after emotional stress or trauma; bradykinin-mediated; treated with C1 inhibitor.

topics.q: 局部麻醉藥過敏的真實頻率（真正 IgE 媒介過敏罕見）與牙科診間的全身性過敏性反應(anaphylaxis)、乳膠(latex)過敏
topics.r: Robbins p.184-185: type I hypersensitivity; systemic anaphylaxis after drugs (e.g. penicillin), insect venom or foods, within minutes; laryngeal edema, bronchoconstriction, shock; epinephrine.

topics.q: 牙科材料的第四型過敏：鎳(nickel)、甲基丙烯酸酯(methacrylates)接觸性過敏，汞合金(amalgam)相關的口腔苔蘚樣病變(oral lichenoid lesion)
topics.r: Robbins p.189-191: type IV (T cell-mediated) hypersensitivity; contact dermatitis is a CD4 T-cell reaction to modified self proteins (check whether nickel is named on the page); delayed reactions take 24-48 h.

topics.q: 尋常性天疱瘡(pemphigus vulgaris)的口腔病灶：常為首發部位、比例、desmoglein 3 抗體
topics.r: Robbins Table 6.3 (p.187): pemphigus vulgaris is an antibody-mediated (type II) disease; antigen in the intercellular junctions of epidermal cells (desmoglein); antibody-mediated protease activation disrupts adhesion; skin vesicles (bullae).

topics.q: 全身性紅斑性狼瘡(systemic lupus erythematosus; SLE)的口腔病灶：盛行率、型態（潰瘍、盤狀病灶）、分類標準中的口腔潰瘍
topics.r: Robbins Table 6.9 (p.197): oral or nasopharyngeal ulceration (usually painless) is a classification criterion; skin: malar rash, discoid rash, photosensitivity.

topics.q: 修格蘭症候群(Sjögren syndrome)：唇部小唾液腺切片(labial minor salivary gland biopsy)與 focus score（2016 ACR/EULAR 分類標準）、口乾造成的齲齒(dental caries)與口腔念珠菌病
topics.r: Robbins p.203-204: dry eyes (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) and dry mouth (xerostomia) from immune destruction of lacrimal and salivary glands; periductal and perivascular lymphocytic infiltrate with germinal centers; lip biopsy of minor salivary glands (verify on the page); anti-SS-A (Ro) / SS-B (La); about 5% develop marginal zone lymphoma.

topics.q: 全身性硬化症(systemic sclerosis; scleroderma)的口腔表現：小口症(microstomia)、牙周韌帶間隙增寬(periodontal ligament space widening)、下顎骨吸收
topics.r: Robbins p.204-206: fibrosis of skin and internal organs; mask-like face; Raynaud phenomenon; GI (esophageal) involvement common.

topics.q: IgG4 相關疾病(IgG4-related disease)的唾液腺表現：Mikulicz 病、Küttner 腫瘤（慢性硬化性唾液腺炎 chronic sclerosing sialadenitis）
topics.r: Robbins p.207-208: tumor-like lesions with dense lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate rich in IgG4+ plasma cells, storiform fibrosis, obliterative phlebitis; serum IgG4 often raised; includes Mikulicz syndrome (lacrimal and salivary), Riedel thyroiditis, autoimmune pancreatitis; Fig 6.31C submandibular gland; responds to steroids / rituximab.

topics.q: 口腔慢性移植物對抗宿主病(chronic graft-versus-host disease; cGVHD)：苔蘚樣變化、口乾、NIH 共識診斷標準
topics.r: Robbins p.211-212: GVHD after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation; donor T cells attack the host; acute GVHD targets skin, liver (bile ducts) and GI mucosa; chronic GVHD resembles autoimmune diseases (e.g. skin fibrosis like systemic sclerosis).

topics.q: 人類免疫缺乏病毒(HIV)感染的口腔病灶分類（EC-Clearinghouse 1993）：口腔念珠菌病、口腔毛狀白斑(oral hairy leukoplakia)、卡波西肉瘤(Kaposi sarcoma)、非何杰金氏淋巴瘤、HIV 相關牙周病；抗反轉錄病毒治療後的變化
topics.r: Robbins p.226-228: oral candidiasis (thrush) often an early sign of immune decline; herpes simplex ulcers; Kaposi sarcoma (KSHV/HHV8); B-cell lymphomas; oral hairy leukoplakia = EBV, white confluent patches on the tongue; many of these fall with antiretroviral therapy.

topics.q: 類澱粉症(amyloidosis)的口腔表現與診斷：巨舌症(macroglossia)、牙齦或唇腺切片的敏感度
topics.r: Robbins p.233-234: tongue involvement can cause macroglossia (tumor-like deposits) that hampers speech and swallowing; diagnosis by biopsy (abdominal fat aspirate, gingival or rectal biopsy); Congo red with apple-green birefringence.

topics.q: 高 IgE 症候群(hyper-IgE syndrome; Job syndrome; STAT3 缺陷)的牙齒與口腔表現：乳牙滯留(retained primary teeth)、慢性黏膜皮膚念珠菌病
topics.r: Robbins ch.6 p.217-218 (verify the page): defects in lymphocyte activation; Th17 defects cause chronic mucocutaneous candidiasis; hyper-IgE (Job) syndrome with STAT3 mutations and defective Th17 responses.

topics.q: 台灣 HIV 流行病學在地數據（衛生福利部疾病管制署，最新年度新增通報數、主要傳染途徑、年齡層）
topics.r: Robbins p.219: worldwide epidemiology; sexual, parenteral and mother-to-infant transmission; in the US men who have sex with men are the largest group.
topics.sources: 衛生福利部疾病管制署 official statistics (not journals)

relevance.high_means: mouth, teeth, salivary glands, tongue, gingiva, oral mucosa, jaw, face, pharynx/tonsil
